questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

JL_N_J_PND_NP_DJ_P_D

options.text: M, D, N, P, N, J, O
M, D, P, N, J, N, O
P, D, M, J, N, O, N
P, M, D, N, J, O, N

questions.solution:
We put all the option in blank area and check who create particular pattern

1) M, D, N, P, N, J, O

J L _ N _ J _ P N D _ N P _ D J _ P _ D

After filling the blanks with the letters/numbers in the option given above, we get:

J L M N D / J N P N D / P N P N D / J J P O D

No particular pattern is repeating itself when the sequence is divided into equal parts.

2) M, D, P, N, J, N, O

J L _ N _ J _ P N D _ N P _ D J _ P _ D

After filling the blanks with the letters/numbers in the option given above, we get:

J L M N D / J P P N D / N N P J D / J N P O D

No particular pattern is repeating itself when the sequence is divided into equal parts.

3) P, D, M, J, N, O, N

J L _ N _ J _ P N D _ N P _ D J _ P _ D

After filling the blanks with the letters/numbers in the option given above, we get:

J L P N D / J M P N D / J N P N D / J O P N D

A particular pattern is repeating itself when the sequence is divided into equal parts.

Here second letter of word is increasing by +1.

L + 1 = M, M + 1 = N, N + 1 = O.

4) P, M, D, N, J, O, N

J L _ N _ J _ P N D _ N P _ D J _ P _ D

After filling the blanks with the letters/numbers in the option given above, we get:

J L P N M / J D P N D / N N P J D / J O P N D

No particular pattern is repeating itself when the sequence is divided into equal parts.

Hence, ‘P, D, M, J, N, O, N’ is the correct answer

questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘RAJ’ is coded as ‘87’ and ‘GITA’ is coded as ‘148’. How will ‘VARUN’ be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is :

**Sum of the positional values of the letters × total number of the letter = number.**

RAJ → Total number of letter is 3.

R(18) + A(1) + J(10) = 18 + 1 + 10 = 29

Sum of the positional values of the letters × total number of the letter = number

29 × 3 = 87

**And,**

GITA → Total number of letter is 4.

G(7) + I(9) + T(20) + A(1) = 7 + 9 + 20 + 1 = 37

Sum of the positional values of the letters × total number of the letter = number

37 × 4 = 148

**Similarly,**

**VARUN** **→ Total number of letter is 5.**

**V(22) + A(1) + R(18) + U(21) + N(14) = 22 + 1 + 18 + 21 + 14 = 76**

**Sum of the positional values of the letters × total number of the letter = number**

**76 × 5 = 380**

Hence, **VARUN** will be written as **“****380”.**

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(12, 121, 169)
questions.solution:
Given: (12, 121, 169)

The Logic here is as follows:

**1st number**

**2ⁿd number = (1st number – 1)² **

**3rd number = (1st number + 1)²**

Now follow these steps,

1st number → 12

2ⁿd number = (1st number – 1)² = (12 - 1)² = 11² = 121

3rd number = (1st number + 1)² = (12 +1)² = 13² = 169

We get, (12, 121, 169)

**Now we check all the options-**

**Option (1): **(16, 161, 256)

1st number → 16

2ⁿd number = (1st number – 1)² = (16 - 1)² = 15² = 225

3rd number = (1st number + 1)² = (16 + 1)² = 17² = 289

We get, (16, 225, 289)

But option (1) given (16, 161, 256) this option don’t follow the pattern.

**Option (2): ****(17, 256, 324)**

**1st number → 17**

**2ⁿd number = (1st number – 1)² = (17 - 1)² = 16² = 256**

**3rd number = (1st number + 1)² = (17 + 1)² = 18² = 324**

**We get, (17, 256, 324)**

**this option follows the pattern.**

**Option (3): **(11, 144, 196)

1st number → 11

2ⁿd number = (1st number – 1)² = (11 - 1)² = 10² = 100

3rd number = (1st number + 1)² = (11 + 1)² = 12² = 144

We get, (11, 100, 144)

But option (3) given (11, 144, 196) this option don’t follow the pattern.

**Option (4): **(14, 196, 225)

1st number → 16

2ⁿd number = (1st number – 1)² = (14 - 1)² = 13² = 169

3rd number = (1st number + 1)² = (14 + 1)² = 15² = 225

We get, (14, 169, 225)

But option (4) given (14, 196, 225) this option don’t follow the pattern.

**Hence, option (2) is correct answer.**

questions.question: The monthly income of three cricketers Ankit, Sanjay and Roshan, from different sources, are in the ratio of 12 : 9 : 7, and their expenditures are in the ratio 15 : 9 : 8. If Ankit saves 25% of his income for future investments, what is the ratio of the savings of Ankit, Sanjay and Roshan?
questions.solution:
__**GIVEN:**__

**Income ratio **of Ankit, Sanjay and Roshan is respectively: **12x : 9x : 7x**

**Expenditures ****ratio **of Ankit, Sanjay and Roshan is respectively: 

**15y : 9y : 8y**

__**FORMULA:**__

**Savings = Income - Expenditures**

__**CALCULATION:**__

**Saving ****ratio** of Ankit, Sanjay and Roshan is respectively:

** (12x - 15y) : (9x - 9y) : (7x - 8y)**

**[Saving ratio = Income ratio - Ependiture ratio]**

Ankit saves 25% of his income, So **saving of Ankit is**

12x - 15y = 25% of 12x

⇒ 12x - 15y = (1)/(4) × 12x

⇒ 12x - 15y = 3x

⇒ 9x = 15y

⇒ (x)/(y) = (15)/(9)

 ⇒ (x)/(y) = (5)/(3) (divided by 3)

So, **x = 5; y = 3**

Put the value of x and y saving of Ankit, Sanjay and Roshan,

(12x -15y) **:** (9x - 9y) **:** (7x - 8y)

⇒ (12 × 5 - 15 × 3) : (9 × 5 – 9 × 3) : (7 × 5 - 8 × 3)

⇒ (60 - 45) : (45 - 27) : (35 - 24)

⇒ 15 : 18 : 11

Hence, **‘15 : 18 : 11’** is the ratio of the savings of Ankit, Sanjay and Roshan.

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs that can sequentially replace the * signs and make the equation correct.

45 * 24 * 72 * 20 * 12 * 7

Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 
 

 12
 34
 110
 
 

 6
 13
 35
 
 

 9
 ?
 60
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Here the pattern followed in **each Row** is:

**[ 3rd number + (1st number × 5) ] ÷ 5 = 2ⁿd number**

Row 1: [ 3rd number + (1st number × 5) ]

[110 + (12 × 5)] ÷ 5

= [110 + 60 ] ÷ 5

= 170 ÷ 5

= 34 = 2ⁿd number

Row 2: [3rd number + (1st number × 5)]

[35 + (6 × 5)] ÷ 5

= [35 + 30] ÷ 5

= 65 ÷ 5

= 13 = 2ⁿd number

Similarly

**Row 3: ****[3rd number + (1st number × 5)]**

**[60 + (9 × 5)] ÷ 5 **

**= [60 + 45] ÷ 5**

**= 105 ÷ 5**

**= 21 ****= 2ⁿd number**

Hence, **“21” **is correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

(Difference of 1st column and 2nd column number) × 5 = 3rd column

(34 - 12) × 5 = 22 × 5 = 110

(13 - 6) × 5 = 7 × 5 = 35

Similarly,

We take ? = 21

(21 - 9) × 5 = 60

12 × 5 = 60

60 = 60

Hence, the correct answer is "21".
